annotations.title: Euler V2 Vault & EVC Sub-Account Auditor

description: Use this tool when a user wants to audit an Euler V2 (EVK) vault, decode uint16 compact floating-point supply/borrow caps, simulate Euler IRM borrow kink slippage, or inspect Ethereum Vault Connector (EVC) 256-bit XOR sub-account bitmaps.

accountAddress.description: Optional Ethereum wallet address to scan EVC sub-account prefixes (0..3)

simBorrowDelta.description: Simulated additional borrow amount in underlying units (default: 2000000)

vaultAddress.description: Euler V2 EVault address (defaults to flagship Euler V2 Prime USDC Vault)

name: audit_euler_v2_vault_and_evc_subaccounts
title: Euler V2 Vault & EVC Sub-Account Auditor
